question: Should Crabbox permanently reserve `CRABBOX_LEASE_ID`, `CRABBOX_RUN_ID`, and `CRABBOX_SLUG`, even when existing users explicitly forward values with those names?
rationale: The implementation deliberately replaces user-controlled environment values with a new core contract; code review cannot determine whether that upgrade behavior is the intended permanent namespace policy.

options.title: Adopt the reserved namespace
options.body: Approve the three names as Crabbox-owned metadata, document the upgrade behavior clearly, and land the implementation after removing the release-owned changelog entry.

options.title: Preserve existing forwarding
options.body: Keep existing user-provided values by using an opt-in metadata mode or differently named variables rather than overriding the current forwarding path.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Pause the PR until a narrower issue or design decision establishes the stable environment-variable namespace.

recommendation.title: Adopt the reserved namespace
recommendation.body: Approve the three names as Crabbox-owned metadata, document the upgrade behavior clearly, and land the implementation after removing the release-owned changelog entry.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work connects steipete to Crabbox execution behavior, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the intended namespace contract.
